blocks.title: Observe
blocks.text: A rectangular C# 2D array uses [row,column]. Example seats has 2 rows and 3 columns.

blocks.title: Explain
blocks.text: A 3D array uses [layer,row,column]. new int[2,3,4] holds 24 integers; its last valid index is [1,2,3].

blocks.title: Apply
blocks.text: Each dimension starts at zero; distinguish [1,2,3] from a single flat offset and never exceed a dimension's length.

blocks.title: Worked example · Trace and justify
